name: Paris
notes:
LitArbi 0.9.0-beta “Paris” — in line with macOS 0.9.9. Matters, bundles, Word documents and licences stay interchangeable.
• Awards & decisions cite in the Jus Mundi style: short case name, case number, decision type, date and ¶ — fill the reference fields in the Info tab, paste a reference, or detect it from the cover page. New “Awards & decisions” template in Settings ▸ Citation with presets.
• Duplicates: identical and probable duplicates are flagged in the list, listed under Library ▸ Duplicates, warned about during import (Skip this file), and reviewed in Matter ▸ Find Duplicates….
• Merge Exhibits: fold two halves of a document into one exhibit, optionally combining the PDF pages — Undo Last Merge puts everything back.
• Translation & AI Protocol: every translation, AI summary and AI read is logged per matter; export as CSV or print for the file.
• Sidebar with Smart Lists (Included, Do not cite, Unnumbered, Needs OCR, Not translated), Exhibit Types and Languages with counts; search scope (titles / details / full text); ✦ marker for AI summaries; tag colour dots; Recent Matters and taskbar jump list; remembered selection and page.
• Document language detected locally, shown as a column and in the inspector; Detect Document Language for a selection.
• Print Document and Print Document List; Rename Exhibit; Find & Replace in Titles; regrouped context menu and Home ribbon; files can be opened with LitArbi from Explorer.
• Word: award template in the add-in data file, longer citations keep working (bookmark names capped), Convert to Plain Text touches only LitArbi citations.
• Fixes: shared files survive Delete Permanently; a lapsed offline check with a live subscription says “Needs an online check” instead of “expired”; safe transcription uploads.
